scope: Security patch of 0.8.0 (Q-44): remediates the ClawHub 0.8.0 findings (command-token exposure to Hosted; local recording after stop) and hardens the keyed argument digest, executable-name classification, bound-write stop handling and coverage reporting. No feature, compatibility or license-term change; same OpenClaw 2026.10.9 contract.

known_limitations: Shadow evaluation classifies only the first command word (e.g. `touch x; rm y` is evaluated as touch).
Executables outside the reviewed canonical list are sent only as the class observa:unlisted-executable.
Unsupported command syntax is reported locally as NOT_EVALUATED, not evaluated by Hosted.
A Hosted request already in flight when stop lands cannot be recalled; its delivery acknowledgement may still be recorded locally.

v7_license_authorization.scope: Exact V7 closure in this distribution; excludes separately distributed private Hosted services, commercial control-plane code and unreleased SDK software.
